Subject: EU-only processing confirmation + VPC requirement (SOC2/SIG asked)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has a short list of must-haves before we can move a supplier to security review. Two asks we need explicit confirmation on: 

1) Can you commit to EU-only processing for all customer data for our account (including logs, metrics, and model inputs) and sign an appropriate DPA with SCCs?
2) We operate under a regulated medical device workflow — procurement will require a VPC endpoint or dedicated private connectivity rather than public API access. Can you describe the VPC options (hosted dedicated vs. customer-managed) and any limitations on telemetry or monitoring when VPC is in place?

Also their security team requested SOC 2 summary, a completed SIG row for the vendor questionnaire, and a network diagram. Attaching our standard procurement checklist.

Can you please confirm next steps and an estimated time to provide the artifacts?

Best,
Elise Brun
Head of IT Procurement
MediSys Health

Attachments: MedSys_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (attachment referenced by sender)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing confirmation + VPC requirement (SOC2/SIG asked)

Elise — thanks for the clear asks and the checklist. Looping in Hannah (security/compliance) and Rishi (solutions) to confirm details. Quick summary from our side up front:

- Yes, we can commit to EU-only processing for your account. We support region pinning and will include this in the DPA with SCCs.
- VPC options: Hosted Dedicated VPC (Redwood-managed within EU region) or Private deployment (customer VPC peering or on-prem). Both can be configured to minimize telemetry collection; we can provide a network diagram and a short list of telemetry keys that are persisted for billing and operational observability.

Hannah — can you confirm SOC 2 and SIG artifacts availability and any caveats on log retention when VPC/private is selected? Rishi — can you assemble a high-level network diagram and note timelines for a VPC onboarding runbook for Medisys.

Next steps we propose:
- Hannah shares SOC2 summary + completed SIG CSV by EOD Dec 2
- Rishi provides VPC diagram and runbook draft by Dec 3
- We prepare a DPA with SCCs draft for legal review once Medisys confirms the requested region enforcement

Thanks — I will keep procurement updated on the timeline.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber

Hi all — following up with the artifacts and a few technical clarifications. See attached: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, SIG-completed.csv, and DataProcessingAddendum_v2.docx (DPA template with SCCs placeholders). Key points: 

- EU-only processing: we will enforce processing within EU regions for Medisys by default and include an account-level clause in the DPA. This includes model inputs, logs, and metrics. Backups and disaster recovery copies will also be kept in-region unless you explicitly authorize cross-border transfer.
- SCCs: we use the latest European Commission standard contractual clauses and include a sub-processor list. The DPA template shows where SCCs will be appended.
- SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II; the attached summary covers scope and last audit date (2026-06). Full report can be shared under NDA.
- VPC options: 
  * Hosted Dedicated (recommended for quickest onboarding): Redwood provisions dedicated networking within our EU region and provides a managed endpoint. We restrict telemetry to minimal operational metrics; full request/response logs are optional and can be disabled.
  * Private deployment (on-prem or VPC peering): you control the network; our control plane can be private or customer-managed. In this mode, we limit persistent telemetry to billing counters and health checks; forensic logs are available via customer-controlled storage.

Limitations & notes: 
- When using VPC/private deployments, certain automated multi-region failover capabilities are restricted unless you approve cross-region redundancy.
- HIPAA note: if you require HIPAA BAAs in addition to GDPR protections, we can provide BAA language in the DPA; we'll need to confirm the scope of PHI processing.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, SIG-completed.csv, DataProcessingAddendum_v2.docx

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
